verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Copilot supports models 'optimized for... multimodal inputs'. Combined with agent mode and the cloud agent completing tasks autonomously, this implies image-informed code generation is possible, but nothing documents turning a sketch, image, or PDF design into a working app. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of image or sketch attachment for app generation, PDF design input support, design-to-app workflow docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
